listeningQuestions.audio: In most countries, turning eighteen marks the start of adulthood.
opts: 在大多数国家,年满18岁标志着成年的开始。
在大多数国家,孩子十岁就要工作。
成年从来没有固定的年龄。

listeningQuestions.audio: This time tomorrow, I will be taking my driving test.
opts: 明天的这个时候,我正在考驾照。
我昨天已经考过驾照了。

listeningQuestions.audio: He took out a bank loan to pay the deposit on his first apartment.
opts: 他申请银行贷款来支付第一套公寓的押金。

listeningQuestions.audio: Real maturity is also about the small, everyday choices you make.
opts: 真正的成熟只关乎年龄。
成熟意味着不再做任何决定。
真正的成熟也在于你每天做出的小选择。

listeningQuestions.audio: Will you be using the computer this evening? If not, may I borrow it?
opts: 今晚你会用电脑吗?如果不用,我能借吗?

listeningQuestions.audio: Whatever our choices are, we should cherish these moments in life.
opts: 无论我们做什么选择,都应珍惜生命中的这些时刻。
我们应该尽快忘掉这些时刻。
只有快乐的时刻才值得记住。

quizQuestions.q: At eighteen, you finally reach the ____, the age of majority.
I don't have a ____ income yet, so a credit card could be risky.
Growing up taught me that ____ means doing right even when no one watches.
The change has been more ____ and gradual than I had imagined.
Don't call me at eight tonight — I ____ dinner with my family then.
While you are lying on the beach next week, I ____ for my final exams.
I promise I ____ the household bills as soon as I get my first wage.
"____ the car tomorrow, Dad? I'd like to drive to the library."

opts: 从前我自私,如今我学着替别人着想。
quizQuestions.audio: Instead of being the selfish teenager I used to be, I now think of others.

opts: 我明天反正要去图书馆,顺便帮你还书。
quizQuestions.audio: I will be going to the library tomorrow anyway, so I can return your books.

reading.passage: Many teenagers think that turning eighteen will change everything overnight. In truth, growing up is a slow and gradual journey. Real maturity grows from the quiet, everyday choices we make, long after the birthday party is over.
reading.passageCn: 许多青少年以为年满18岁会让一切一夜之间改变。事实上,成长是一段缓慢而循序渐进的旅程。真正的成熟来自我们每天做出的不起眼的选择——远在生日聚会结束之后很久。

questions.q: What do many teenagers wrongly believe about turning eighteen?
opts: That they must leave home at once.
That they will lose all freedom.

questions.q: Where does real maturity come from, according to the passage?

writing.prompt: Write 3-4 sentences about your plans for the future. Say what you will be doing in a year, what you plan to study, and what job you hope to do. Try to use the future continuous, e.g. 'This time next year, I will be …'.
writing.promptCn: 用3-4句话谈谈你对未来的计划:一年后你将在做什么、打算学什么、希望从事什么职业。试着用将来进行时,如 'This time next year, I will be …'。

lines.text: Your eighteenth birthday is coming. What are you most looking forward to?
Being able to vote, I think. And this time next month, I'll be taking my driving test!
lines.cn: 我想是能投票吧。而且下个月的这个时候,我就在考驾照了!

lines.text: That's exciting. Aren't you nervous about becoming an adult?
lines.cn: 真令人兴奋。你不紧张成为大人吗?

lines.text: Not really. Growing up is gradual, so I'll just take it one step at a time.
lines.cn: 不太紧张。成长是逐渐的,我会一步一步来。
